scientific.integrity: The result combines the exact Rademacher second moment of the Hutchinson diagonal estimator with AdaHessian's bias-corrected RMS weights. A separate two-dimensional extremal calculation gives the sharp condition-number inflation factor.
limitations: The exact RMS target is for a fixed Hessian and no spatial averaging.
The statement concerns the expectation of the squared RMS state, not the expectation of the RMS itself.
The multi-probe law assumes independent probes averaged before the RMS square.
Spatial averaging and the later Hessian-power nonlinearity require separate analyses.

title: Exact off-diagonal curvature leakage in AdaHessian's Hessian RMS
